title: The Reward Revolution
description: Trace the evolution of reinforcement learning from Pavlov's dogs to modern RLHF. Discover how our understanding of reward-driven learning in biological systems directly inspired the algorithms that now align AI behavior.
targetAudience: Anyone interested in how reward shapes both biological and artificial intelligence
keyTakeaways: Pavlov and Thorndike discovered that reward shapes behavior
Dopamine neurons compute the same signal as TD learning algorithms
RLHF uses human preferences to align AI with human values
PPO is the workhorse algorithm behind ChatGPT's training
